description: Operations that declare `idempotent: true` with no replay evidence. Every entry is ONE operation with an owner and a review date — there is no wildcard and no module-wide waiver, because a class-wide suppression would hide the next one silently, which is exactly what this check exists to prevent. A NEW unproven promise fails the gate immediately.
context: EMPTY, and empty is the finished state rather than a disabled one. CSA-22 recorded ten P1-14 IAM and organisation-settings operations that promised idempotency with nothing exercising the promise. All ten now have real replay evidence: tests/backend/p1-14-idempotency-replay.test.ts drives each through its exported route handler and proves the retry writes no second row, no second audit record and no second outbox event, and that the same key with a different payload is refused rather than silently replayed. `check-idempotency-evidence.mjs` reports 107 of 107 idempotent operations proven and 0 waived.

closure.closedBy: RootLco CodeQL Application Remediation and Security Hardening
closure.provenance: Imported by cherry-pick from fix/p1-14-idempotency-replay-evidence@c27b2a06680b1325a76b08c0f7f6ff51e2174711, authored 2026-07-28, with authorship preserved.
closure.whyNotMergedSeparately: Merging that branch on its own would have made all ten entries below stale, and a stale exception is a HARD FAILURE in check-idempotency-evidence.mjs — the stale-exception loop marks an entry `used` only inside `consider()`, which runs for unproven operations only. Measured on the reconciled tree before this file was emptied: 107/107 proven, 0 unproven, and ten `matches nothing` failures, exit 1. That gate is called unconditionally by _reusable-integration-tests.yml under `set -euo pipefail` and is a `ci-gate` dependency, so develop would have gone red on the push. The evidence and the removal therefore had to land together.
